name: Swarm of Flies refreshes ranked Taldaram's Torment on Bloodbolt (#13499)
contract: Swarm of Flies 704646 procs Spread Taldarams 704647 on Bloodbolt damage (rev_20260918_33). 704647 effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_REFRESH_AURA (173) with MiscValue 800772 (Taldaram's Torment Rank 1, spell_ranks chain 800772, 802568-802573, 802580) and BasePoints 14999 + DieSides 1 = 15000 ms. Spell::EffectAscensionRefreshAura previously used exact target->GetAura(effect.MiscValue), so only Rank 1 (800772) was refreshed and Ranks 2-8 were ignored. At the reported level 38, casting Taldaram's Torment Rank 5 (802571), letting 5 s elapse, and landing Bloodbolt Rank 5 (806931) must refresh 802571 back toward 15 s (at least +4000 ms over the pre-Bloodbolt snapshot).

steps.label: SETUP: Taldaram's Torment Rank 5 is applied
Let Taldaram's Torment decay for 5 s
Taldaram's Torment Rank 5 duration before Bloodbolt
DISCRIMINATING: Bloodbolt refreshes Taldaram's Torment Rank 5 duration
